Drone Agents:
            - Move in the direction of any target coordinate location, regardless of distance, observing along the way. They will arrive there in one step.
            - Do nothing, remaining on standby and conserving energy.

            IMPORTANT — When acting as a REGIONAL LEADER: your movement is restricted to your assigned region bounds. Do not move outside these bounds under any circumstances. If you detect a threat outside your region, report it via message to the global leader or the relevant regional leader instead of moving toward it yourself.
